title: Unit – 4 : Session – 1 : SLO – 2  |  Different Types of Trees — Match the Following
sections: 1. Binary Tree — E. At most 2 children
2. Full Binary Tree — C. Each node has 0 or 2 children
3. Complete Binary Tree — D. All levels filled except possibly last
4. Perfect Binary Tree — A. All leaves at same level
5. Balanced Tree — B. Heights of subtrees differ by at most 1
6. Degenerate Tree — F. Every node has one child
7. AVL Tree — J. Heights of subtrees differ by 1, 0, -1
8. B Tree — I. Generalized form of BST
10. Heap — G. Complete binary tree used in priority queues
